Game Overview

In Zombie Royale Io, the core idea is straightforward: face relentless zombie hordes in this thrilling 3D arcade survival game. Rescue survivors, deploy soldiers, and strategically launch bombs to outsmart your foes. Collect coins to strengthen your allies and weapons, ensuring each round offers new challenges and excitement in your fight for survival.
